title: Total-Loss Refund Calculation for Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Total-Loss Refund Calculation

**Clause.** The total-loss refund on a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan is the plan's standard refund, rounded half up to the cent. The standard refund depends on the plan's refund method:

| Plan's refund method | Standard refund |
|---|---|
| Pro rata unused visits (the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit) | Purchase price times unused visits, divided by visits included. Unused visits are visits loaded, less visits redeemed, plus visits reinstated. |
| Retail-value deduction (the Essentials, Plus and Premium plans) | Purchase price less the plan's retail value per visit for each visit used. Visits used are visits redeemed less visits reinstated. |

No cancellation fee is deducted.

**Combination clause.** Credits that apply are added to the rounded refund. That sum is then floored at 0.00 and capped at the purchase price, in that order, at the end. A plan cancelled within its free look period of calendar days after its sale date with no visit used, or sold on a Vehicle Purchase Agreements deal that now stands unwound, is instead refunded its full purchase price, and the computation above is not used.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plans)
| Plan | Inputs | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Pro rata | Price 1,050.00; 12 included; 5 unused | 1,050.00 times 5, over 12, is 437.50 |
| Retail-value | Price 640.00; retail value 115.00; 2 used | 640.00 less 230.00 is 410.00 |
| Retail-value, below zero | Price 300.00; retail value 120.00; 3 used | Rounded refund of minus 60.00; plus hypothetical credits of 25.00 gives minus 35.00, floored to 0.00 |
| Cap | Rounded refund 590.00 on a price of 600.00; hypothetical credits of 25.00 | 615.00, capped at 600.00 |

In the third row, the credits are added to the negative rounded refund before the floor is applied.
